collections.label: Products
collections.description: Sellable products. Published products are mirrored to Stripe.

fields.label: Price (minor units, e.g. grosze; the base price of the product and its variants)
Specification (edit it in the Specification panel)
Gallery (more pictures; for a product without variants, or shared by all variants)

collections.label: Product types
collections.description: Which attributes make up a variant (up to three axes) and which ones a product specifies.

fields.label: Allowed values (empty for an axis = all of its values)
Required specifications (a subset of the above)

collections.label: Attributes
collections.description: Properties products are described by (Colour, Size, Material) and their values.

collections.label: Brands
collections.description: Brands products belong to; each has its own page.

collections.label: Categories
collections.description: Product categories; a category can have subcategories.

collections.label: Variants
collections.description: Sellable combinations of a product's axes (one value per axis). Edited from the product.

fields.label: Option values (one per axis of the product type)
Price override (minor units; empty = the product price)
Gallery (more pictures of this variant, e.g. one colour)

collections.label: Attribute values
collections.description: The choices of an attribute (Black, M). Edited from the attribute.

collections.label: Prices
collections.description: One-time or recurring prices of a product or one of its variants. Edited from the product or variant.

fields.label: Product (set this or the variant, not both)
Variant (set this or the product, not both)
Managed by the plugin (mirrors the product / variant price)

collections.label: Orders
collections.description: Orders created by the plugin from provider events. Money and Stripe fields are read-only.

collections.label: Customers
collections.description: Guest customers identified by email and linked to one Stripe customer. Read-only.

collections.label: Subscriptions
collections.description: Provider subscriptions mirrored from Stripe. Read-only.

collections.label: Payments
collections.description: Provider payments (checkout payments and subscription renewals). Read-only.

collections.label: Carts
collections.description: Admin mirror of shopping carts (best effort; the authoritative cart lives in plugin storage).

collections.label: Order events
collections.description: Append-only timeline of an order (status changes, refunds, disputes, emails, notes). Shown inside the order.

collections.label: Feedback
collections.description: Dev tool: comments left on page elements with the editing pill (Notes). An agent marks them done.

collections.label: Homepage
collections.description: Content of the home page (intro image)
